description: NaIO₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pna2₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.94 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one I atom. The O-I bond length is 1.84 Å. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one I atom. The O-I bond length is 1.83 Å. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one I atom. The O-I bond length is 1.83 Å. I is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms.
